basic_info.description: Stunning Craftsman home beautifully situated on wonderful tree-lined block, close to West Portal Village shops, restaurants & Muni Station! Delightful garden entrance w/inviting walkway leads to an elegant arched portico w/terrazzo steps & notable front door & into a gracious foyer w/classic wood craftsman staircase, gorgeous leaded glass window above & convenient coat closet. Magnificent formal living rm w/double-recessed 'Art Deco' ceiling boasts a fireplace w/expansive mantel, built-in bookshelves, enormous five-sided bay-window & lovely hardwood floors. Banquet-size formal dining rm w/huge wall-to-wall bay-window & striking chandelier! Impressive remodeled gourmet kitchen w/breakfast area & direct access to the backyard showcases all stainless-steel appliances incl a Bosch gas range w/hood, marble counters w/snazzy green tile backsplash, apron sink, custom designer painted wood cabinets w/slow-close drawers, pantry w/pull-out drawers, built-in shelving & a menu-planning desk. Master BR enjoys three large closets & dressing rm. Separate, private guest quarters, comfortable family rm, laundry rm w/LG W&D + utility sink. Amazing, walk-out park-like landscaped backyard w/tradesman's entrance, flagstone patio, sweeping lush lawn & splendid garden w/colorful, mature plants & trees!
